personal.headline: Technical Lead | .NET, Azure and Cloud Architecture

summary: Technical Lead with 11+ years of experience leading engineering teams and delivering cloud-native software across the complete SDLC. Specializes in .NET, Azure, microservices, event-driven integration, and enterprise platforms including Dynamics 365 and Salesforce. Known for translating business goals into pragmatic architecture, mentoring engineers, and improving delivery quality through clear technical standards and automation.

bullets.text: Lead a 12-member engineering team delivering .NET Core and Azure solutions for field service, workflow automation, and customer operations platforms
Defined microservices, CQRS, and event-driven integration patterns that reduced release dependencies and supported 99.9% service availability
Established standards for architecture reviews, code quality, automated testing, observability, and secure Azure deployments across four product teams
Partnered with product and business stakeholders to convert complex operational requirements into measurable delivery plans and technical roadmaps
Designed REST APIs, background jobs, and Azure integrations for enterprise systems processing more than 2 million monthly records
Migrated legacy ASP.NET MVC workloads to ASP.NET Core services with Entity Framework and SQL Server, improving deployment frequency and maintainability
Built integrations between Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, and third-party systems using Web API, Logic Apps, and Service Bus
Guided the adoption of automated testing with NUnit, MSTest, Moq, and NSubstitute for critical business workflows
Delivered web applications and service integrations using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, and SQL Server
Built mobile and IoT workflows with Ionic, Angular, Xamarin Forms, Arduino, MQTT, and Azure IoT Hub

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

projects.name: Field Service Resource Optimization Platform
projects.description: Led the modernization of a map-driven scheduling platform matching field resources with service requirements by location, availability, and timing. Owned architecture, technical delivery, and integration reliability for a 12-member team.

projects.name: Candidate Compliance Workflow Platform
projects.description: Designed a modular workflow platform for background verification and compliance activities, introducing service boundaries, asynchronous processing, and operational dashboards for high-volume workflows.

projects.name: Enterprise CRM and ERP Integration Hub
projects.description: Architected reliable interfaces between Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, and partner systems with retry handling, monitoring, and secure message processing.

projects.name: Temperature-Controlled Inventory Monitoring
projects.description: Built an IoT prototype that captured temperature telemetry, evaluated threshold breaches, and raised corrective-action tickets in Dynamics 365 CRM for temperature-sensitive inventory.
